summary: The planner now omits the generic skipped-by-reason count for records already parked under the closed no-evidence reason, so each such record is counted once in notReadyByReason; the replan regression test asserts that single count.

evidence: src/host/matrix-planner.ts:388-395 skips the skippedByReason increment when the blocker message starts with NO_CI_AND_NO_LOCAL_VERIFY_BLOCKER, leaving the later closed-reason count as the single count.
tests/host/matrix-planner-no-test-evidence_test.ts:124-132 replans after the park and asserts skippedByReason is empty while notReadyByReason has exactly one no-evidence count.
